title: make the next choice easier
tldr: Reviews take too long to answer. This ticket makes each one open on a short overview and a clear recommendation.

words.quote: I just want to see the choice and why
words.from: You, when you sent this ticket

picture.caption: Words before the first choice
picture.alt: Today a review runs 640 words before the first choice, and after the change it runs 120.

steps.say: it moves the long explanation behind one closed section.
steps.does: Render supporting detail inside the collapsed builder section

plans.seen: you will see a review you can answer in under a minute.
risk: A short overview can leave out something you wanted to know.
Old reviews keep the long form.
undo: The old form comes back with one change.
done: The next review opens on the overview
The full explanation is one tap away
plans.proof: The next review, in the new form.

questions.question: How much should we show first?

options.label: A short overview
options.detail: Show the outcome, the choices, and why we recommend one.
options.say: the worker makes each review open on a short overview.
options.does: Open with the outcome, the choices and the recommendation

options.label: The full explanation
options.detail: Put the supporting detail beside every choice.
options.say: the worker makes each review open on the full explanation.
options.does: Open with the supporting detail beside every choice

options.label: The next review
options.detail: Try one example and adjust after your feedback.
options.say: it tries the new form on the next review only.
options.does: Apply the format to the next review and collect feedback

options.label: Every review
options.detail: Use the new form everywhere at once.
options.say: it switches every review to the new form at once.
options.does: Apply the format to every open review
